# Arcway Board 4.1: optional weekly digest

## Overview for workspace coordinators

Starting **October 6, 2026**, **Team workspaces** can use a weekly email digest to catch up on cards whose status or due date changed. The feature is **off by default**. No workspace is enrolled automatically, so coordinators can decide whether the weekly email fits their team's routine. Personal workspaces are not eligible.

Once enabled, the digest is scheduled for **Monday at 09:00 in the workspace time zone**. It offers an email view of recent changes without changing the in-app activity feed. Members who do not want email updates can make a personal notification choice.

The weekly digest is optional for eligible workspaces. Eligible workspaces are not required to use the weekly digest.

## Adoption details

### Enable a workspace digest

The weekly digest is available to **Team workspaces starting October 6, 2026**. It is **off by default**, and enabling it requires a workspace coordinator. Personal workspaces cannot enable it. These steps are for a coordinator choosing to start weekly delivery for a workspace.

1. Open **Settings > Updates**.
2. Turn on **Weekly digest**.
3. Choose **Save**.

The workspace is then eligible for the next scheduled delivery: **Monday at 09:00 in the workspace time zone**. If you enable the setting on Monday after 09:00, the first delivery is the following Monday. Turning it on after that day's scheduled time does not move the schedule later in the day.

### Understand the schedule and contents

Check the zone displayed under **Settings > Workspace** when discussing delivery time with members. The workspace zone controls scheduling; a member's device time zone does not change it. For example, a workspace set to `America/Chicago` sends at 09:00 America/Chicago even when a member travels. Use the workspace's setting when deciding which Monday delivery will be the first one.

Each digest includes cards whose **status or due date changed since the previous Monday at 09:00**, measured in the workspace time zone. It is an email digest, sent to current workspace members who have email updates enabled. The in-app activity feed continues to work as before; enabling the digest does not change that feed.

### Choose whether you receive email updates

If you are a member who wants to stop receiving email updates, open **Profile > Notifications** and turn **Email updates** off. This is your personal notification choice. It does not turn off Weekly digest for the workspace or change the workspace's Monday delivery schedule. Other current members with email updates enabled remain eligible to receive the digest.

### Stop future workspace deliveries

A workspace coordinator can open **Settings > Updates**, turn **Weekly digest** off, and choose **Save** to stop future weekly deliveries for the workspace. Email that has already been delivered is not withdrawn. The in-app activity feed is unaffected by this setting, so turning the digest off does not remove that way of following card changes.
